quest_wildflower_commission.title: A Posy for Riverside
quest_wildflower_commission.description: Elder Thorne would like a hand-tied wildflower posy for the village's newest residents.

stages.description: Gather herbs, craft a wildflower posy, and deliver it to Elder Thorne.
stages.completion_dialogue: A small kindness, thoughtfully made. Riverside is fortunate to have you here.

quest_riverside_charm_commission.title: A Riverside Welcome
quest_riverside_charm_commission.description: Elder Thorne needs a carved charm for a new household settling near the river.

stages.description: Craft a carved Riverside charm and deliver it to Elder Thorne.

quest_river_fine_token_commission.title: A Token Worth Keeping
quest_river_fine_token_commission.description: Elder Thorne seeks a carefully made river-clay token using unusually fine local material.

stages.description: Craft a River Fine token and deliver it to Elder Thorne.

quest_museum_showcase_commission.title: A Light for the Museum
quest_museum_showcase_commission.description: Curator Vane is seeking a display-worthy stone: refine one yourself, or source a suitable specimen through other pursuits.

stages.description: Bring Curator Vane one display-worthy stone by any accepted route.
stages.completion_dialogue: The cut catches the light beautifully. This will help visitors see the valley's treasures anew.

quest_scout_forest.title: Eyes in the Woods
quest_scout_forest.description: Scout the forest to locate the bandit camp.

stages.description: Locate the Hidden Camp in the Whispering Woods.
stages.completion_dialogue: You found it? Good. We need to deal with their leader.

dialog.greeting: Hold! You have the look of someone sent by the village. I am willing to listen before I spill your blood. What do you want?

success.description: You convinced him to stand down. Peace is possible.

quest_kill_bandit_king.title: Regicide
quest_kill_bandit_king.description: Put an end to the rebellion by slaying the King.

stages.description: Kill the Bandit King in the forest clearing.
Deliver the Peace Treaty to the Bandit King.
Search for clues about the missing guard.
stages.start_dialogue: One of my recruits went missing near the river. Please, see if you can find any trace of him.
stages.completion_dialogue: By the gods... this is his tabard. And it's covered in strange slime. Take this to Kaelan the Alchemist immediately.

stages.description: Show the Bloody Tabard to Kaelan the Alchemist.
stages.start_dialogue: Go to Kaelan. He will know what creature left this slime.
stages.completion_dialogue: Hmm. River Troll slime. Acidic and foul. The beast must be nearby. Slay it before it takes more victims!

stages.start_dialogue: The troll is the cause. Kill it.
stages.completion_dialogue: The beast is dead? You have done the village a great service today.

quest_investigate_smuggling.title: Something's Not Right at the Docks
quest_investigate_smuggling.description: Investigate the source of Portbridge's smuggling rumors.

stages.description: Search the harbor district for signs of smuggling activity.
stages.completion_dialogue: An underground cache? So it's true -- someone's running goods through my harbor without paying a cent in tariffs. Find out who's behind it. Carefully.

quest_smuggler_contact.title: The Smuggler's Offer
quest_smuggler_contact.description: Confront whoever is running the smuggling operation beneath Portbridge.

stages.description: Confront the smugglers' leader in the underground cache.

dialog.greeting: Well now. You found us. Question is -- what are you going to do about it? I could use someone with your nerve... for the right price.

success.description: You strike a deal. Welcome to the crew.

fail.description: She doesn't like your terms. Steel is drawn.

stages.description: The negotiation failed. Deal with the smugglers' leader.

quest_smuggler_delivery.title: Cutting You In
quest_smuggler_delivery.description: Bring the dubious cargo to the smugglers to seal the deal.

stages.description: Deliver the dubious cargo to the smugglers' leader.
stages.completion_dialogue: Good. This is what trust looks like. You've got a share coming to you.
